initial_rejection_reason: No-motion fixture could not satisfy the old mandatory movement/device checkpoint. New explicit input_notifications restoration validates changed-input callbacks and rejects any carrier; default strict scope remains unchanged. The b capture passed independently.
limits: No entity transport, bounce, sliding, items, fluids or inventory.
Direct piston destruction in movement paths and previously unsupported movable devices remain rejected.
Source-map hash bucket exceeding eight keys is rejected rather than inventing Java collision-resize iteration order.
Native comparison covers the declared projection, not hidden registers/history or all shape/inert-target callbacks.
Known-space, placement permissions/size and non-atomic world mutation constraints remain.
Retired contexts/checkpoints and old Blueprint passes are not automatically converted or reused.
